stem.text: An ambulance travels along a straight road at a speed of $30.0\,\text{m s}^{-1}$. Its siren emits sound of frequency $2000\,\text{Hz}$. The speed of sound in the air is $340\,\text{m s}^{-1}$. The ambulance passes a man standing at the side of the road.
What is the frequency of the sound heard by the man as the ambulance moves towards him and as the ambulance moves away from him?
